name: David Aquino
headline: Chief Operating Officer for $100M+ CPG, Apparel & Beauty ◈ Althaea Skin ◈ Medical Device companies
about:
Thirty years building and running operations at scale — from $135M family-owned businesses to $2B global platforms to NASDAQ-listed companies — across consumer goods, apparel, medical devices, and specialty retail.

The through-line is simple: take complex, broken, or underscaled operations and make them best-in-class. That means owning the full stack — supply chain, manufacturing, IT, finance, logistics, customer experience — and driving the kind of measurable outcomes that show up on P&Ls. +800 BPS gross margin. $50M inventory reduction. +30% revenue growth. 96%+ fill rates at companies ranging from SharkNinja to HydraFacial to Scrubs & Beyond.

Currently leading Stratix Growth, a special situations advisory firm providing interim COO/CIO leadership to distressed and underperforming businesses. Portfolio engagements include serving as GM & COO of Althaea Skincare — a luxury medtech brand built around CARA, a first-in-class FDA Class II multi-modal device (RF, EMS, dual-wavelength LED) developed by board-certified dermatologist Dr. Ava Shamban and supported by a 100-participant, 13-week clinical study. Currently directing the FDA 510(k) regulatory pathway, with clearance expected June 2026.

Earlier: EVP Global Operations & IT at The Beauty Health Company (NASDAQ: SKIN / HydraFacial), COO/CIO at Kindthread (Scrubs & Beyond), EVP at SharkNinja, and EVP COO/CIO at Barco Uniforms. Founded and sold a company during COVID-19. Approved qualified bidder for the IP of Rite Aid and Francesca's in their respective bankruptcy proceedings. Research Director at Gartner/AMR Research with 50+ published reports. CPIM certified. MBA, Fordham.

Open to COO, CSCO, and EVP Global Operations opportunities where operational transformation, turnaround experience, and executive leadership across functions are what the business needs.
… more

experiences.description:
Stratix Growth is a special situations advisory firm focused on operational turnarounds, distressed PE portfolio company rescue, venture maturation and strategic restructuring for underperforming businesses. The firm provides hands-on interim executive leadership — COO, CIO, and GM — embedding directly into companies to stabilize operations, reduce costs, and build the infrastructure needed to scale or exit.

Current and recent engagements span consumer electronics (Nine Stars), personal care brands, specialty distribution (Maryland Fire Equipment), and medtech (Althaea Skincare, where David serves as GM & COO overseeing an FDA Class II medical device through 510(k) clearance).

Stratix has also been an approved qualified bidder for the intellectual property of major retail brands in bankruptcy proceedings, including Rite Aid and Francesca's — applying deep operational expertise to distressed asset evaluation and special situation M&A.

Sponsors, board members, and founders navigating underperformance, transition, or exit are encouraged to connect.

Althaea Skincare is a luxury medical-grade skincare and device company built around the science of chronobiology — the principle that skin has its own circadian rhythm governing cell regeneration, hydration, and barrier protection. The brand was developed by board-certified dermatologist Dr. Ava Shamban and anchored by a proprietary topical line engineered to sync with the skin's biological timing systems.

At the center of the brand is C·A·R·A — a first-in-class multi-modal FDA Class II medical device that integrates three distinct energy technologies: Radio Frequency (RF) for collagen and elastin stimulation, Electrical Muscle Stimulation (EMS) for facial muscle re-education and toning, and dual-wavelength LED therapy (red for anti-aging cellular activation, blue for antibacterial blemish clearing). Backed by an 8-week clinical study, CARA is designed to mirror Dr. Shamban's in-clinic treatment protocols in an at-home format — currently advancing through FDA 510(k) clearance, with approval expected June 2026.

Serving as GM & COO with full P&L ownership across supply chain, finance, sales, and marketing. Leading the FDA regulatory process in coordination with clinical investigators, while simultaneously building the commercial infrastructure to support medspa and dermatology practice accounts, DTC e-commerce, and at-home subscription models — architected for scale from day one.

experiences.position: Executive Vice President, Global Operations & IT
experiences.description:
Hypergrowth, category-creating, medical device and consumables company delivering beauty health experiences that help consumers “reinvent their relationship” with their skin, bodies, and self-confidence. Flagship brand, HydraFacial™, created the category of hydra-dermabrasion by using a patented vortex-fusion delivery system to cleanse, extract, and hydrate the skin with proprietary solutions and serums including partners like Allergan, Murad, Jlo Beauty, NassifMD, and Dr. Dennis Gross.

Member of the Executive Committee reporting directly to the CEO, leading a 200+ person Global Operations organization manufacturing ($50M), shipping ($250M) and supporting over 30k HydraFacial devices operating in physician, med-spa, esthetician offices, and hotels in over 90 countries. 

Accountable for total supply chain and IT spanning engineering, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, quality, distribution, customer service, and technical/field
support.

Successfully launched next generation HydraFacial devices in APAC and EMEA incorporating the latest technology and learnings from the US launch a year prior.

Built new advanced analytics, technical and field support organization for our connected medical devices that quickly identified additional quality assurance and engineering needs. Our team was able to launch a third-generation device in record time which allowed the restoration of HydraFacial’s historical reliability and reputation.

Implemented globally outsourced manufacturing model in Asia allowing a massive reduction in material cost, geographically advantaged final assembly and end-to-end gross margin improvements of more than 800bps per year.

Modernized planning, engineering, quality assurance and manufacturing organization leading to a $50M inventory reduction while improving instantaneous order fill rates and eliminating expedited freight by over 80% YoY.

A founding leader of $350M disruptor in the Healthcare Apparel space weaving together the largest retailer Scrubs & Beyond with over 116 retail stores in the US with the acquisition of three heritage brands in Landau, White Cross and Chefwear with the mission of providing the healthcare industry a true modern, omni-channel experience with the best choice of fashion, fit and locations.

Hired by and reported to the founder and CEO of the largest ($550M) Medical Apparel company that owns important scrubs brands like Cherokee, Dickies, Healing Hands, Med Couture as well as one of the largest Healthcare E-commerce retailers AllHeart.

Immediately led functional due diligence, and the subsequent integration of two key acquisitions allowing a smooth post-sale transition that realized contemplated 500bps cost reductions via improvements across product sourcing, supply chain planning, fulfilment operations, and customer service infrastructure.

Drove an emergency expansion of e-commerce distribution between Saddle Creek Logistics and AllHeart precipitated by a historic volume explosion due to COVID-19 as well as the discovery of a failed robotics implementation causing reputational risk. Our focused response reduced backorders by over 80% and nearly eliminated painful multi-day order backlogs.

Spearheaded a crucial response to $100M customer Wal-Mart’s private label scrubs volume explosion needs with a “quick-turn” product innovation approach – dramatically reducing design & construction lead-times over 50% and allowing Wal-Mart to simultaneously maximize revenue and margins across North America.

Quickly became an important and trusted member of the Executive team leading to both a letter-of-intent to purchase our family company CertainSupply and asked by CEO to drive aspects of the Sell-Book that facilitated the company’s sale to Partners Group for $1.2B at the end of 2021.

- Recruited to address historical operational and technology challenges in a company that launches thousands of new items annually while ensuring seamless operations, including availability, quality, cost, and flexibility. 

- Implemented strategic changes resulting in best-in-class performance across various domains, including a 10% increase in Customer Service Levels, Inventory Efficiency boost (2.5 to 4.3 Inventory Turns), 300 basis point improvement in Gross Product Margin, and substantial cost reductions.

- Facilitated a targeted modernization of Technology infrastructure, enhancing capabilities in Product Design, Product Lifecycle Management, Analytics, Sales Force Automation, Disaster Recovery, Human Resources, and Enterprise Immune System.

- Drove Strategic planning, meticulous process development, and adept organizational design have propelled Barco to attain exemplary performance standards across key operational domains, including Product Development, Global Sourcing, Supply Chain Planning, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality Assurance, and Enterprise Technology.

Revenue Growth: +34%, Gross Margin: +300 BPS, EBITDA: +98%, Fill Rates: 96.1%, Inventory Turns: 4.3.
